mapper.select: SELECT id FROM sys_dept WHERE deleted = 0 AND FIND_IN_SET(#{id}, ancestors)

SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_dept WHERE parent_id = #{id} AND deleted = 0) THEN '部门存在下级部门，请先处理下级部门' WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_user WHERE dept_id = #{id} AND deleted = 0) THEN '部门仍有用户，请先调整用户归属' WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_post WHERE dept_id = #{id} AND deleted = 0) THEN '部门仍有岗位，请先处理关联岗位' WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_role_dept role_dept INNER JOIN sys_role role ON role.id = role_dept.role_id AND role.deleted = 0 WHERE role_dept.dept_id = #{id} ) THEN '部门仍被角色数据范围引用，请先调整角色授权' END
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_dept SET ancestors = CONCAT(#{et.ancestors}, ',', #{et.id}, SUBSTRING(ancestors, CHAR_LENGTH(#{previousPath}) + 1)), update_by = #{et.updateBy}, update_time = #{et.updateTime} WHERE deleted = 0 AND FIND_IN_SET(#{et.id}, ancestors)
